info.name: Waves Pest Control Public API
info.description:
Free, read-only JSON endpoints for Florida lawns and homes, from Waves Pest Control & Lawn Care in Southwest Florida: a weekly lawn watering plan, a monthly pest pressure forecast by city or ZIP, a monthly yard pressure calendar for lawns, shrubs and weeds, and the county Pest Pressure Index. No key and no sign-up. CORS is open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), so a web page on any site can call them. Please cache responses: they carry Cache-Control headers, and the data changes a few times a day at most. The forecast and the calendar are seasonal, weather-based models, not measurements.

AI agents can use the same data through the public MCP server at https://portal.wavespestcontrol.com/api/public/mcp (MCP Registry name com.wavespestcontrol/pest-control).

Docs: https://github.com/wavespestcontrolfl/waves-lawn-tools/blob/main/docs/public-api.md

query.description: A city slug from /api/public/pest-forecast/locations. Send `location` or `zip`.
A 5-digit Florida ZIP code. Send `location` or `zip`.
Turf type.
Sprinkler head type.
Current minutes per zone, used with `head`.
`1` if the system has a rain sensor, else `0`.

request.description: Last 7 days of measured rain, this week's forecast, the turf's weekly need and a run or hold decision under the local watering limit. `plan.action` is `run`, `hold`, `need_only` (no watering order is tracked for that county, so the answer is the lawn's need only) or `unavailable`. Every answer links the county's water management district rules in `rulesUrl`; local rules always come first. Limit: 120 requests in 15 minutes from one address.

item.name: County averages of technician pest-activity ratings (Pest Pressure Index)

query.description: `json` (default) or `csv` (text/csv, one row per group).

request.description: The Southwest Florida Pest Pressure Index: county averages of the pest-activity rating (0 None to 5 High) that Waves technicians record at completed service visits. Only county and service-line groups with 20 or more visits in the window are listed; smaller groups are counted in hidden_groups. It is an average of technician ratings, not a survey and not a forecast. Data license: CC BY 4.0. Page: https://www.wavespestcontrol.com/pest-pressure-index/.

response.name: 200 The index (JSON)
